description:
## Goal

Separate executable content identity from diagnostic source-location ownership so a source-location-only edit preserves backend/native allocations and generations without leaving stale diagnostics.

## Evidence

During fz-tfn.12 macro acceptance, replacing fn offset(), do: 1 with fn offset() do 1 end reproduced otherwise equal BackendExecutable values. BackendClause.span and BackendEntry.span alone differed: original CodeId 1 range 0..18 versus replacement CodeId 4 range 0..22. BackendProgram derives PartialEq through these spans, so RootBackendContent generation advanced 1 to 2 and woke the macro source consumer although executable behavior was unchanged. This coupling predates bridge deletion; fz-tfn.12 retains exact existing artifact equality rather than masking source changes.

## Strategy

Start with a failing real macro/source-replacement test and a diagnostic-location control. Research every backend/native span consumer and source snapshot lifetime before choosing ownership. Give executable content and diagnostic provenance their exact independent owners through the retained product model; do not merely omit spans from PartialEq while returning an old artifact carrying stale spans. Fold concordant source replacement work with fz-tfn.20 and body-incremental native work; delete duplicate source/diagnostic mirrors or adapters introduced during cutover.

## Acceptance

- Formatting/location-only source replacement preserves executable backend/native content allocation and generation, performs no native codegen and does not rerun source consumers whose macro result is unchanged.
- Relevant executable changes still move only exact transitive dependents.
- Errors and runtime/compiler diagnostics after replacement point to current exact source locations, including macro-generated sources.
- Superseded snapshots are retained only by legitimate diagnostic/source owners and reclaimed once unreferenced.
- Deterministic evaluation, generation, allocation and codegen counts prove reuse; canonical artifacts/runtime behavior and diagnostic output remain correct.
- TDD, ticket-scoped cold review, full relevant gates and current documentation; no equality masking, parallel authority or temporary construction debris.
title: Separate diagnostic provenance from retained executable content identity
